scope: Pacific barkcloth and painted wood; Mexican murals; Sahelian manuscripts and Yoruba polychromy

rejected.reason: Photomosaic appears strongly color-processed. An unprocessed baseline and processing history were not established.
Saved file-page category identifies a National Museum of Anthropology reproduction, not an original wall.
Photograph appears to depict a modern copy; the title and category alone do not resolve original versus reproduction.
Source describes Tepantitla, but an original wall versus a museum copy was not independently resolved for this view.
Historic print has a severe magenta cast and blown highlights; inadequate as a useful pigment-study baseline.

review: Source bytes and Commons image metadata plus file-page revisions retained. Native photographs visually inspected before inclusion; historical object dates are separate from capture dates. Three manuscript photographs retain the photographer’s CC BY 4.0 grant despite public-domain artwork metadata.
